name: Fivetran
sku: Fivetran Standard plan, Fivetran Cloud deployment. Hybrid (agent-based) and self-hosted HVR deployment for database CDC exist but are not scored.

ingest.batch-extract.note: 700+ pre-built, fully managed connectors across databases, SaaS applications and files, with automatic schema mapping and incremental syncs. This is what the product is for.

ingest.cdc.note: Log-based change data capture for supported databases extracts row-level changes from the transaction log rather than full-table scans, run as managed, scheduled syncs rather than a continuous stream.

bands.note: The dashboard reports sync status, row counts and logs per connector, with alerting on sync failures and schema changes. It covers connector health, not the data's own quality.

presentation.tagline: Fully managed connectors that extract and load data with automatic schema handling.

cost.note: A $5 minimum applies to each standard connection with 1-1M Monthly Active Rows (MAR); a couple of low-volume connectors at that floor.
Third-party estimate: smaller teams processing under 10 million MAR/month often land $1,250-4,200/month at $500/million MAR (Standard plan).
High MAR volume (tens of millions of rows/month) at Enterprise's $667/million MAR rate; annual contracts can bring 5-36% discounts off this.
